title: Stalk comparison after extending a separably closed field
statement: Let S be a scheme, k and kprime separably closed fields, s:Spec k -> S and sprime:Spec kprime -> S, and beta:k -> kprime such that Spec(beta) followed by s is sprime. Precomposition gives a natural bijection between the etale lifts defining these points [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For any category B with the required colimits it induces a natural isomorphism of B-valued stalk functors. This comparison carries each germ to the same section at its extended lift.

source.place: Tag 04FN, remark-map-stalks: a field-extension map of geometric points gives an isomorphism of stalk functors, preserving germ representatives

proof.text: Precomposition on etale lifts is injective by cancellation of the field embedding on scheme morphisms. Every lift after extension descends by the separably closed etale lifting theorem. The slice morphism equations give the bijection over S.

The bijections are natural by associativity and give an isomorphism of point fibre functors. Reverse the point arrows according to the definition of the point category; applying Point.Hom.sheafFiber gives the stalk isomorphism. Its inverse identities follow from the point identities. Point.toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberDesc proves the stated formula on germs.
